ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream pixels in the lateral lobe regions against 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels in the medial and marginal zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation zones across the mid-sections of both lobes. A thick, dark vertical band dominates the central peduncle attachment area. Extensive yellowish-tan mottled staining (diatom film) is concentrated across the lower ventral margin. Distinctive vertical dark streaks are mapped on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 40-45 degrees, showing a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and frequent serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged amplitude variations observed particularly on the inner-half of the left lobe and the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric outward convex sweep from the notch, terminating in sharply tapered, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white/calcified pixel groupings (barnacles) localized on the extreme outer tips and leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, dark vertical 'rake' marks or linear scratches visible on the right lobe, cutting through the white pigmentation and diatom film.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) on distal tips; irregular trailing edge morphology suggesting historical wear or minor predatory interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan biological film coverage across the lower 40% of the visible ventral surface area.
